text:
Sofia (CS): quick flag — Polaris preview can't complete SSO assertion; PM reports a SAML mismatch. AM says renewal is high-risk if onboarding delayed >5 days.
Ben (AM): yikes. procurement/legal already asking for timeline. can we give them a scoped test harness so eng can start validating?
Liam (Enablement): propose a 30m 'shallow-enable' to demo a shim auth flow + minimal cURL examples. can record the session for product too.
Aisha (SolutionsEng): 30m works. i can stand up a temporary proxy-harness that accepts their SAML and emits a test JWT. it'll be isolated, audited, and time-bound. i need their IdP metadata + the last request-id from their logs.
Sofia (CS): PM said they'll try to export metadata by EOD. i'll nudge and ask for the request-id now.
Ben (AM): if we do a proxy-harness, legal asked for a time-bound access note and the standard pilot addendum. can someone own that?
Liam (Enablement): i'll loop legal and confirm the addendum template. we labeled it 'engineering preview harness' last time and legal was fine.
onboard-bot: Test harness provisioned: https://redwood.example/harnesses/polaris-harness-57 - expires 2024-12-01T00:00Z. Audit trail: enabled.
Aisha (SolutionsEng): sample curl i'll paste into the quickstart and run in the session:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer TEST-HARNESS-TOKEN" \\
  -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate
```
Liam (Enablement): perfect. i'll prepare a 1-slide quickstart: 3-step swap from harness -> real SSO, plus a 1-question pulse at the end: "Did you validate your core flow? yes/no". we'll push the result to CRM (account tag: polaris-pilot).
Sofia (CS): onboard-bot, please create a 30m invite for Thu 2024-11-21 16:00 UTC — attendees: Sofia (CS), Liam (Enablement), Aisha (SolutionsEng), Ben (AM), Polaris PM.
onboard-bot: Calendar invite created: Thu 2024-11-21 16:00-16:30 UTC - "Polaris preview: shallow-enable (30m)" - link: https://meet.redwood/example/polaris
Ben (AM): leaving a renewal-mitigation note on the account: 'pilot harness offered; session scheduled; legal looped'.
Sofia (CS): next steps: 1) PM exports metadata + request-id (ASAP). 2) Liam draft slide + pulse + recording plan (Tue EOD). 3) Aisha configure harness + write quickstart with curl (Tue EOD). 4) Ben prepare pilot addendum draft (Tue EOD).
Aisha (SolutionsEng): ack.
Liam (Enablement): ack.
Sofia (CS): thanks team  ping here when metadata uploaded; i'll escalate to procurement if no reply in 24h. :rocket:
onboard-bot: Reminder scheduled: 48h before session  send join link + pulse.
